sources.entry: MyIP ⚠ - All in one IP Toolbox. Easy to check what's your IPs, IP geolocation, check for DNS leaks, examine WebRTC connections, speed test, ping test, MTR test, check website availability and more. (Demo, Source Code) MIT Nodejs/Docker

summary.one_liner: MyIP is a self-hostable, all-in-one IP toolbox that shows your public IPs, looks up IP geolocation and ASN data, and runs network and privacy tests such as DNS leak, WebRTC, speed, ping and MTR checks.
summary.what_it_does: The toolbox detects IPv4 and IPv6 addresses from multiple sources and shows country, region, city, ASN and organization for each. It also looks up any IP you enter, and keeps a local IP history stored in the browser only. Leak and privacy tools cover WebRTC IP exposure, a DNS leak test, an ad and tracker blocking test, and a browser fingerprint view. Network tools include a connectivity check for up to 60 chosen sites, a speed test, global latency pings and MTR routes from worldwide probes, censorship checks, and a proxy rule test. Lookup tools include a multi-resolver DNS resolver, Whois search, MAC vendor lookup, an IP calculator, and ASN profiles. A curl API returns your IP from the terminal.
use_cases: check my public IP address and geolocation
detect DNS or WebRTC leaks while using a VPN or proxy
test website reachability and censorship from different countries
run ping, MTR and speed tests from the browser
look up Whois, ASN or MAC vendor details
calculate subnets and convert IP notation
how_to_run: git clone <repository URL from the README>
notable: Runs many lookup and network tests in one web app, including DNS leak, WebRTC, MTR and censorship checks
Shareable diagnostic reports with auto-expiring read-only links, Markdown or JSON output
IP history and browser fingerprint data are kept in the browser only
Interface ships in 6 languages with a curl API for terminal use
Global probes for latency and MTR tests are drawn from Globalping, as named in the README
caveats: Geolocation and ASN lookups need free MaxMind GeoLite2 credentials, otherwise the MaxMind source returns 503
ALLOWED_DOMAINS must be set on a real domain, or non-localhost requests get 403
Documentation for configuration and environment variables is hosted separately at docs.ipcheck.ing
